description: Provisional commercial office fit-out productivity in units per worker per 8h shift. Source confidence and validation status accompany every activity. Production CLI uses detailed activities, resource formula and inspection gates.
rate_level_semantics: low = pessimistic productivity (fewest m2/worker-day -> longest duration), typical = planning default, high = optimistic productivity (shortest duration). A task may pin `rate_level`; otherwise default_rate_level applies. The chosen level and the full table are echoed in the explainable fields, together with the duration the same task would take at every level.

suspended_ceiling.label_zh: 天花吊顶 (龙骨 + 封板/矿棉板)
suspended_ceiling.rate_basis: Office fit-out, 2.7-3.0m ceiling, exposed-grid mineral fibre or gypsum lay-in incl. hangers/main tees/cross tees and board fixing. Industry rule-of-thumb 8-15 m2/worker-day; typical 10 until field-calibrated.

legacy_template_bridge.note: Legacy WBS tasks carry no quantity. When the pilot is on, tasks whose name contains a match keyword are tagged suspended_ceiling and quantity = gross area x ratio (net ceiling area). Derived quantity downgrades confidence. When the Quantity Engine (core/quantity_engine.py, config/quantity_benchmarks.json) supplies derived quantities, the entry's quantity_key (ceiling_area) is used instead of this ratio; the ratio stays as the fallback when no engine output is passed.

source.note: No verified external source or site observations. Scenario planning only; validate scope and worker-day output with trade contractor.

partition_framing.label_zh: 隔墙轻钢龙骨骨架搭设
partition_framing.rate_basis: Office fit-out, 2.7-3.2m wall height, 75/100 series C-stud + top/bottom track at 400/600 c/c, incl. setting-out, studs, noggins and door/glazing openings. Quantity = wall area measured on one face; boarding excluded (belongs to the boarding/painting chain). Rule-of-thumb 10-20 m2/worker-day framing only.

legacy_template_bridge.note: Legacy task `隔墙轻钢龙骨骨架搭设`. Partition wall area (one face) for an open-plan office with meeting rooms is roughly 0.6 x gross floor area; derived quantity downgrades confidence.

flooring.label_zh: 地面铺装 (架空地板 / 地砖 / 地毯)
flooring.label_en: Floor finish (raised access floor / tile / carpet)
flooring.rate_basis: Blended office floor finish on a prepared, levelled slab. Single-finish rules of thumb: carpet tile 40-60, raised access floor 20-30, porcelain/ceramic tile 8-12 m2/worker-day. Blended typical 25; pin a single finish with the `finish` factor.

legacy_template_bridge.note: Legacy task `架空防静电地板/地砖/地毯铺设`. Net floor finish area is roughly 0.9 x gross floor area (core, shafts and partition footprints excluded); derived quantity downgrades confidence.

painting.label_zh: 墙顶底漆及面漆（不含基层处理）
painting.rate_basis: Provisional primer and finish coats only; preparation is separate wall_prep. Existing rate values require trade validation for this revised scope.

legacy_template_bridge.note: Legacy task `天花封石膏板与墙顶乳胶漆饰面` is a composite (ceiling gypsum boarding + paint). Painted surface is roughly 1.8 x gross floor area (both faces of partitions ~1.2 + painted gypsum ceiling ~0.6). The bridge pins factor scope=with_ceiling_board (x1.5) so the boarding work is not silently dropped; the label is visible in the explainable fields. Derived quantity downgrades confidence.
